scripts.android:sync: npm run build && cap sync android
scripts.android:apk:debug: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug && cd .. && echo 'APK: android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk'
scripts.android:apk:release: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease && cd .. && echo 'APK: android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk'
